m.lib.sub: Tigrumma n ticraḍ yettwafernen, yebnan ɣef Quran. Yal azday isali Taɛrabt-is am wakken tella d tsuqilt yettwaḥerzen seg uɣbalu — ulac kra i yettwaxelqen dagi.
m.set.tafLangSub: Tutlayt n tafsir · Taglizit d asellak
m.set.topicsLayoutSub: Amek d-banen isental yettwawellhen deg Unadi
m.set.sourcesSub: Iccer n iɣbula n Quran Facts
m.onb.s1b: Aru kra n usentel, tikti, neɣ asteqsi. AskQuran d-yettarra tayatin yemṣadan — Taɛrabt, tasuqilt, d tafsir — yettwabedren srid seg iɣbula yettwafihrisen.
m.onb.s2b: Yal tiririt tettwacar yerna ur tettwabeddel ara. Ulac aḍris n ddin yura-t AI, ulac tirga — Quran kan, tisuqilin tiṣeḥḥaḥin, d tafsir yettwacaren.
m.onb.s3b: Sbadu tutlayin n usnas, n tsuqilt, d tafsir. Tzemreḍ ad tbeddleḍ yiwet seg-sent melmi tebɣiḍ deg Iɣewwaren.
m.splash.tagline: Nadi Quran. Ɣer kan iɣbula yettwacaren.
m.about.lede: Abrid yebnan ɣef iɣbula akken ad tessekneḍ Quran: ticraḍ, tasuqilt, d tafsir — ttwaskanen war abeddel.
m.about.p0b: Yal agmuḍ d-yettak kan Taɛrabt n Quran am wakken tella (Tanzil), tisuqilin yettwaḥerzen, d tafsir yettwaḥerzen. Asnas werǧin yura asegzi n ddin yerna werǧin ibeddel aḍris n uɣbalu.
m.about.p1b: Anadi isdukkul tayatin yemṣadan s wudem ibeddun seg ufihris — tremseḍ aɣawas n uɣbalu yettwacaren, mačči d tiririt yettwarun.
m.about.p2b: Tafsir tettwaskan akken tewwi tella war abeddel yerna werǧin tettwasuqil s tmacint neɣ tettwabeddel s tsusmi gar tutlayin.
m.about.p3b: Yal taya tewwi iɣbula-ines — Taɛrabt, tasuqilt, d (mi d-tettwaskan) tamentilt n tafsir — akken yal taɣawsa ad tezmir ad ttwaḍfar ɣer uɣbalu-ines.
m.about.footer: Anadi n Quran s tedrart n iɣbula · ticraḍ, tasuqilt d tafsir
m.foot.builtBy: Yebna-t Dilawar Abbas s tallalt n Ghazala Zafar am Sadaqah Jariyah.
m.foot.free: AskQuran d baṭel, war idellisen, yerna ad yili akka i lebda. Ur d-yessutur ara tikciwin. Tririyin-is bnan kan ɣef Quran, tisuqilin tiṣeḥḥaḥin, d tafsir, war kra n uḍris n ddin yettwaxelqen.
m.foot.dua: Ad iqbel Allah aɛeddi-yagi, ad t-yerr d win yenfaɛen, ad isameḥ kra n laɛyub.
